method: Researcher-coded public-record motifs used only in three-source composites. These motifs describe documented public roles or conduct, not a person's complete or true psychology. Names, dates, places, quotations, and signature events are excluded from generated benchmark profiles.

sources.record_basis: Competitive performance, improvisational talent, and team leadership

sources.name: Josef Stalin
sources.record_basis: Concentration of personal power, coercive control, and elimination of rivals
